threads.body: In v3 preview mode, using the legacy target names (kafka-broker / kafka-connect) currently results in a generic "configuration not found" error. Logging an explicit warning when v3 preview is enabled and a legacy name is used would make the failure mode much more actionable.

replies.body: this will be documented in release notes for major version bump

threads.body: README now uses the experimental Kafka target names, but it doesn’t mention that legacy names (kafka-broker / kafka-connect) are still accepted outside v3 preview (with a warning) and that v3 preview requires the experimental names. Adding this note would prevent user confusion during the transition.
